goal: As Tomasz Wierzbicki, create a draft resource estimate for PRJ-0409 Kettle Lake: ordinary kriging, cut-off 0.3 % Ni, Indicated 4.2 Mt at 1.35 % Ni and Inferred 6.8 Mt at 1.10 % Ni.
diagnosis: The run went wrong on the Resources landing page reached from the project Resource tab. The page offered All estimates, the register that leads to New estimate; the atlas framed it as browsing existing estimates. Projects looked like the route back to the chosen project, so the run looped between the project and Resources.

lessons.what: Opens the estimate register, where New estimate starts an estimate for a project.
lessons.not_for: In review is for estimates already in review; Portfolio resources is for released-value charts.
lessons.why: At the Resources landing page, the estimate-register route was implicit, so Projects looked more relevant.
lessons._old_what: Opens the list of every resource estimate, any status; the number is how many there are.
lessons._old_not_for: Only the estimates in review (In review). It does not create an estimate (New estimate, on the list).

lessons.what: Resources landing page for released-estimate value charts and the price-deck summary.
lessons.not_here: New estimate lives in All estimates. In review holds estimates already in review; Price deck holds commodity prices and cut-offs.
lessons.why: The page text routed review items, but left the starting point for a new estimate unclear.
lessons._old_what: Landing page of Resources: in-situ value at the corporate price deck for every project with a released estimate, as headline figures (total value, estimates in review, measured + indicated share, release requests pending), charts by project, commodity and category, and a table of released estimates by project.
lessons._old_not_here: This page counts released estimates; drafts and estimates in review: Resource estimates (All estimates / In review). Screening with a price factor or recovery: In-situ value. The project links in the table open the project's own resource tab in Projects, and the estimate id links open the estimate.

lessons.what: Opens the Projects register and project records, with tabs for each project's details.
lessons.not_for: New estimate lives in Resources, All estimates; Resource tab shows a project's estimate history.
lessons.why: Projects drew the agent away from the estimate workflow on the Resources landing page.
lessons._old_what: Opens the Projects section: the register of exploration projects and each project's record (tenure, programmes, team, budget, gates).
lessons._old_not_for: The portfolio-wide overview (Portfolio) or field work on a project (Programmes).
